# 92. Börsen är en kyrka med en strippklubb

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-10-14  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is an interview episode of Veckans Trade with the Swedish trader TGODTRADER. It covers his path from market making at Remium to full-time trading, his psychology and risk management, and how he trades sentiment and forced sellers. He gives past trades as examples: a big intraday buy in Surgical Science after it gapped down 80%, buying the AI dip during the Aschenbrenner fund liquidation, buying the Trump-tariff panic, and an undisciplined losing swing in Truecaller. The tone is mostly about trading process. There are almost no forward-looking stock calls; the only directional remark is a joking intro teaser about buying more Novo Nordisk.
